## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `googleapis-sheets-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Create a Google cloud platform project

1. <!-- manual: Open the [Google Cloud Platform Console](https://console.cloud.google.com/). -->
2. Select **Select a project** in the top navigation bar and either select an existing project or click **New Project**.
3. <!-- manual: Give your project a name (e.g., Ballerina Sheets Integration) and click Create. -->

## Step 3: Enable the Google sheets API

1. <!-- manual: In the GCP Console, select your project. -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to APIs & Services › Library. -->
3. Search for `Google Sheets API` and select it.
4. Select **Enable**.

## Step 4: Configure the OAuth consent screen

1. <!-- manual: In the left sidebar, navigate to APIs & Services › OAuth consent screen. -->
2. Select **External** as the user type.
3. Select **Create**.
4. <!-- manual: Fill in the required app information (App name, User support email, Developer contact email). -->
5. <!-- manual: Add the necessary scopes for Google Sheets API (e.g., https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets). -->
6. <!-- manual: Save and continue through the remaining steps. -->

## Step 5: Create OAuth client credentials

1. In the left sidebar, select **Credentials**.
2. Select **+ CREATE CREDENTIALS** and choose **OAuth client ID**.
3. Set **Application type** to **Web application**.
4. <!-- manual: Enter a name (e.g., Ballerina Sheets Client). -->
5. <!-- manual: Under Authorized redirect URIs, add https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground. -->
6. Select **Create**.
7. <!-- manual: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from the confirmation dialog. -->

## Step 6: Obtain access and refresh tokens

1. <!-- manual: Open the [OAuth 2.0 Playground](https://developers.google.com/oauthplayground). -->
2. <!-- manual: Click the gear icon (settings) in the top-right corner and check Use your own OAuth credentials. -->
3. <!-- manual: Enter your Client ID and Client Secret. -->
4. In the left panel, find and select **Google Sheets API v4** scopes (e.g., `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets`).
5. Select **Authorize APIs** and sign in with your Google account.
6. Select **Exchange authorization code for tokens**.
7. <!-- manual: Copy the Refresh Token from the response. -->
